page.heading: Your numbers, wherever you work
body: Your business numbers move to the cloud, so a call can ring a desk phone, a laptop or a mobile. Staff take calls from the office, from home or on the road, and callers see the same company number.

We set up Teams Phone if you already use Microsoft 365, or a standalone phone system if that fits better. Call menus, hunt groups, voicemail to email and after-hours messages are all set up before the switch.
Your existing numbers come with you. We handle the transfer with your old provider and schedule the cut-over so there is no gap in service.
Desk phones and headsets are picked to suit how each person works. When one fails, we swap it.
page.plans: Included in Complete. An add-on for Essentials and Business. Phone system moves are quoted as a project.

faq.q: Can we keep our phone numbers?
faq.a: Yes. We transfer your numbers from your current provider. Callers will not notice the change.
No. Many staff use a headset and their laptop or a mobile app. Desk phones are there for reception and anyone who prefers one.
Each number is registered to an address, and staff who work from home can update theirs. We set this up and test it before go-live.
